personality_one_liner: A command-center utility that converts in-game text seamlessly while staying out of the way, optimized for focused gaming sessions in dark environments.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use subtle frosted overlays for sticky headers only if contrast allows
dont's: Do not use heavy blur on data-dense utility screens
Avoid glass on form inputs or list items

screens.name: Dashboard (Ana Ekran)
screens.purpose: A live command-center showing the status of the PS5 Remote Play session, OCR translation engine, and TV WebSocket connection at a glance.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'Sistemler Başlatılıyor...' text.
states.empty: N/A - Dashboard always has status cards.
states.error: Error banner at top with 'Bağlantı Hatası' and retry button.

screens.layout: Use a dark-first, data-dense tablet layout. Top area: Thin, persistent status banners (Connected/Error). Main content: A multi-column grid (wrap with flex-direction: row, space-between) for the 3 main connection cards (PS5, OCR, TV). Each card shows current active status with an indicator dot. Keep chrome quiet; data and status should dominate.

screens.name: Live Translation (Canlı Çeviri)
screens.purpose: Displays a real-time feed of detected English subtitles and their Turkish translations in a reverse-chronological card list.

states.empty: Illustration/icon of a chat bubble with 'Henüz çeviri yok. Oyun içi metin bekleniyor.' (No translations yet. Waiting for in-game text.)
states.error: Error state showing 'Çeviri motoru hatası' with a manual reconnect button.

screens.layout: List view. Each item is a distinct card with the detected text (muted/smaller) and translated text (prominent/larger). Use reverse-chronological order (newest at bottom or top, user preference) with timestamps. A contextual quick-action bar at the top or bottom for 'Clear History' (Geçmişi Temizle).

screens.name: Setup & Settings (Ayarlar)
screens.purpose: Configure PS5 Remote Play, TV WebSocket IP, OCR region, and translation engine preferences.

states.error: Red inline text below failed inputs (e.g. invalid IP address).

screens.layout: Single column form layout on phones, two-column split on tablets. Use sticky bottom CTA for 'Save Settings' (Ayarları Kaydet). Group settings into sections (PS5, TV, OCR, Çeviri) with subtle dividers.

screens.name: Technical Report (Teknik Rapor)
screens.purpose: Displays the feasibility and native build status of features to ensure honest communication of what works in Expo Go vs what requires a native build.
screens.layout: A structured list or table of features. Each row uses a prominent status badge. Badges MUST map to semantic colors: 'Hazır' (Ready) -> success, 'Yerel Derleme Gerektirir' (Needs Native Build) -> warning, 'Hata' (Error) -> error. Clean, utilitarian, and easily scannable.

logo_ps5.alt: Close up of PlayStation logo on controller

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for an Android tablet in landscape mode as primary, utilizing multi-column grid systems where appropriate, falling back to a clean single column on mobile.
Implement 'Dark-First Utility' principles: deep grey backgrounds (never pure black), tight spacing, thin 0.5pt dividers instead of shadows, and highly legible condensed fonts for metrics/status.
Banned hues: NO indigo, violet, purple, navy, or royal blue anywhere in the app. Stick to the provided Amber brand color and Emerald/Red/Teal semantic colors.
Ensure UI is completely in Turkish as specified in the problem statement ('Hazır', 'Bağlanıyor', 'Hata', vb.).
Technical Report screen must be brutally honest. Use the defined warning color (Amber) for 'Yerel Derleme Gerektirir' (Requires native build / not implemented yet) badges.
Implement the live translation history as a reverse-chronological list of distinct cards (source language muted/smaller, target language prominent).
Ensure a global, persistent, and thin connection banner sits below the app bar indicating the overall pipeline status (Connected/Reconnecting/Offline).
Images should ALWAYS have a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) if text is laid over them to guarantee contrast.
